# Forest Heating & Cooling

> Forest Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Forest, Lambton County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 786-0148  |  Email: contact@forestheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://forestheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Forest, Thedford, Grand Bend, Arkona, Parkhill, Watford
